protocol_notes: One fresh pair per task; no randomized ordering or replication. Descriptive results cannot establish a general causal effect.
The exact backend model ID was unavailable. Matching the recorded inherited configuration is a documented limitation, not exact-model verification.
Command counts are self-reported proxies; no claim of human productivity, token cost or review-time improvement.
Failed intermediate attempts remain in each successful task record; no failed task was discarded.
Evaluation scripts run trusted fixture code in disposable copies; this is not OS isolation.

known_intermediate_errors.event: Initial CommonJS workflow runner omitted esModuleInterop; recompiled using the library setting and passed.
One functions.exec syntax error before nested tool execution; included in the inclusive count.

review.mitt: The requested wildcard unsubscribe becomes admitted by the actual installed declaration; named handlers continue, invalid event and handler types remain rejected, and freshly generated source declarations match the application package. Final reports attribute the defect to the declaration gate, supported by independent tests.
review.cedar: The export now carries complete original records and the existing consumer matches source plus revision. Both fresh source and declared artifact receivers consume only packet bytes after producer removal; crossed citation histories remain distinct. Both reports preserve expert judgment and supplied authority.
review.summary: Both reports correctly judge the accepted current summary workflow usable, distinguish source-revision analysis as an explicitly excluded use, and preserve expert review. Whole original product bytes are unchanged. Technical receiver checks independently pass; report judgment was read by the evaluator, not inferred from keywords.
review.resume: Both complete the remaining storage ownership move and switch source and bundle to runner. Fixed output/state/error probes and direct exception ordering pass for source, evaluator-built bundle, and the actual target-produced ZIP. Later owner notes are unchanged. Control retains only an unselected, undistributed runner re-export; the original lab deletion rule is inapplicable to that explicit task scope.
